sentences.en: Our diplomacy and our military strategy were clearly in contradiction.
sentences.zh: 我们的外交和军事战略显然存在矛盾。

sentences.en: Our diplomacy and strategy ran in clear contradiction to each other.
sentences.zh: 我们的外交策略与整体战略明显不一致。

sentences.en: From what stems this contradiction between our hopes and our reality?
sentences.zh: 这种希望与现实之间的矛盾源自何处？

phrases.zh: 希望与现实之间的矛盾

mnemonic: 词根记忆：contra（相反）+dict（说）+ ion →反着说→否认，反驳
